=== Docs ===

Top level categories are in their own grouping. Everything else has a parent. Criteria for a parent category: has (or can easily be made to have) three children and/or its children can be sorted by different criteria (e.g. by content, by subject). Categories with <code>(?)</code> may not need to exist. Bolded categories only contain pages as children. All names are tentative.

Useful models:
* [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Category:Contents Wikipedia's top category]
* [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Categorization Wikipedia Categorization Guidance]
* [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Mathematics Wikipedia Mathematics Portal]
* [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Category:Mathematics Wikipedia Mathematics Category]
* [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Areas_of_mathematics Wikipedia page for prose description of not-quite categories]

Useful templates:
* [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Cat_main Main article for category remplate]
